newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Uneximbank plans Sibneft tender result challenge.
newsitem.headline: Uneximbank plans Sibneft tender result challenge.

text.p: Russia's third biggest bank Uneximbank plans a legal challenge of the results of an investment tender for 51 percent of Sibneft oil company, for which the bank's bid was rejected, a spokesman said on Friday.

"I absolutely deny the fact that we could have broken the conditions of the tender," Uneximbank press secretary Modest Kolerov told Reuters. "Using unprecedented pressure the organisers of the tender have done everything possible to prevent Uneximbank from taking part."

The tender for 51 percent of Sibneft, Russia's seventh biggest oil producer, was won by the hitherto unknown OOO Finansovaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya (FNK), with a bid of $110 million against a starting price of $101 million.
The stake had been held in trust by another little known oil industry investment vehicle, ZAO Neftyanaya Finansovaya Kompaniya (NFK).
It took control of the stake in late 1995 under the government's shares-for-loans scheme with a credit to the government of $100.3 million.
NFK is controlled by Boris Berezovsky, a leading Russian businessman and security adviser to President Boris Yeltsin.
